### Marked by Newness
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-july-2-2025.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 8:19-20
Points:
- Israel's request for a king was driven by a sinful desire to conform to the surrounding pagan nations.
- Wanting to blend in with their neighbors meant compromising their distinct identity as God's set-apart people.
- Modern believers face the same cultural pressure to adopt worldly patterns of thought and behavior.
- Christians are called to resist societal conformity and exhibit a distinctive, Spirit-shaped way of living.

### Israel Sinfully Demands a King
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/israel-sinfully-demands-a-king
Passage: 1 Samuel 8:19-20
Points:
- Israel sinned by wanting a proud, self-reliant ruler like the Gentiles instead of relying on God to fight their battles.
- Despite Samuel's clear warnings about the costly oppression a monarchy would bring, the people refused to listen.
- The Lord instructed Samuel to grant their request, showing that divine judgment sometimes involves giving people what they stubbornly demand.
- Chasing after sinful desires can result in God handing people over to the destructive consequences of their own choices.
